reviews.title: Devils!!! Christian App, Questionable Billing Practices!!!
reviews.text:
These people draw you in by using some of our favorite, well-known Christian figures to promote their app!

I downloaded Hallow because I wanted to participate in 30 days of prayer with Coach Prime. Instead, I didn’t even get to enjoy the full seven-day free trial I expected!

I CANCELED MY SUBSCRIPTION THROUGH APPLE, AND I WAS STILL CHARGED! NOT ONCE, BUT TWICE!!! Approximately $151.18!

I’ve already contacted Apple, and now I have to wait for the charges to finish processing before I can even request my money back!

What makes this especially disappointing is that this app promotes CHRISTIANITY! Integrity, honesty, and accountability should be reflected in the way you conduct business, especially when you’re encouraging people to strengthen their relationship with GOD!

I find this entire experience misleading and unacceptable!

If you’re looking to grow closer to God, download a FREE Bible app and spend time in HIS WORD! You do not need an expensive subscription to have a relationship with GOD!

reviews.title: Profiteers
reviews.text:
The Catholic Church is so wealthy, why is it charging people for access to prayer?

Did Jesus charge people when He healed them? No.
And charging people to attend your retreat virtually that you’re already making money off of is disgusting.

reviews.title: “We’re sorry to see you go!”
reviews.text:
I’m not.

This app was genuinely harmful for me. I live with scrupulosity OCD, and instead of helping me grow in my faith, it intensified my fears and made me feel as though I could never be good enough, no matter what I did. Every spiritual question I asked left me feeling more condemned, more anxious and more hopeless.

It felt cold, robotic and sterile, with very little understanding of how obsessive compulsive disorder affects a person’s spiritual life. People with scrupulosity already live under relentless pressure. We do not need more guilt or impossible standards.

I love God and I love Jesus. This review is not about my faith. It’s about an app that, for me, pushed me further into fear instead of drawing me closer to God’s grace.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I heard that Mark Wahlberg was going to be on Jimmy Kimmel tonight, and wanted to check it out.

I normally don’t like Jimmy Kimmel and find much of what he says to be obscene and offensive, so was hoping to hear Mark Wahlberg talk about his faith and the Hallow app.

I am immensely disappointed, disgusted, saddened and confused by what I saw.  The behavior that he was promoting is in direct contrast to Christian values.

I don’t understand why Hallow would choose him to be part of this ministry. 

He has an amazing platform to share the Catholic faith, but it was evident that he is either deeply and unapologetically hypocritical, or his faith is completely fake.   

I can’t imagine Hallow didn’t know what he was working on when he was not recording prayers for Hallow, and yet, they continue to keep him as a prominent voice for their ministry.

How does Hallow reconcile this hypocrisy?

How do I explain to my kids - or anyone - why it’s ok that the same man who leads us in prayer, also celebrates serving tequila to college students, laughs about pulling his pants down in front of thousands of people and makes a grotesque movie full of profane language, disgusting jokes, violence and graphic nudity (per the rating description)??

I just pray that Chris Pratt and especially Jonathan Roumie are not also fakes.

I usually listen to Hallow with my husband, and recently signed up for my own subscription, but I will no longer be using this app.

reviews.title: Confused
reviews.text:
I found this app in 2022 when I was at my lowest. It gave me hope, I used it daily for years. I noticed little shifts in the material but tried to fight against my instincts. Unfortunately, the app has become political. There isn’t one specific instance, several of the Daily Reflections have nonchalantly referenced political views that feel one sided which is disheartening and made me question my faith more than I’d like to admit. The app used to push the teachings of Jesus and led with love, compassion, understanding, and empathy. I’m so very disappointed to see the switch, yet one more example of how organized religion is pushing division. If you’re reading this and feel the same or discouraged, please don’t stop believing or lose faith, re-focus your attention and focus on how Jesus interacted with outcasts, those who were different, poor, weak, and misunderstood. 
Hallow, please do better and diversify your speakers and demonstrate how Jesus would include all, not just some.

reviews.title: Shame they caved to the AI con
reviews.text:
What a shame Hallow caved to the AI con by including “Magesterium,” supposedly to answer questions about our faith with mindless machine models. “AI” is nothing more than guesswork algorithms and it is not “intelligent”; scriptures and teachings, perhaps above all, need a human touch to explain, decipher, and put into context… context being critical to subtle nuances that AI fundamentally misunderstands and usually gets blatantly false with a posed “confidence” that may lead readers toward false conclusions. Do not believe anything you ask Hallow’s AI: take it to your priest or prayer group if you need clarity.

The response to my initial review by Hallow is appreciated, but also questionable; I’ve read several reviews that claim Hallow’s voice actors are AI, and Hallow denies it, but if they embrace machine AI in one place, they likely embrace it everywhere (or are willing to because it’s the “hot new thing,” but they don’t understand how it works or care about the soulless results). I’d really like to use Hallow, because I see what it might offer, but AI is a firm “no” for me. If anything I’ve said in this review resonates with you, uninstall Hallow and look elsewhere for spiritual or human (not AI) inspiration.

I submitted a refund request twice and I explained the situation, also begging for the refund since I need that 69£ for my daily expense and it was rejected with no response.
